description: End-to-end coverage of the `junit` and `markdown` reporters through the real CLI. A reporter only runs after every spec in its own run finishes, so a spec can never observe its own reporter output — each test seeds a tiny inner spec, spawns a nested `doc-detective` run with both reporters selected, and asserts on the files it wrote. Everything is `node -e` shell work, so no browser or device is needed and every permutation runs on Windows, macOS and Linux. Scratch output goes to `.tmp/` at the repo root, never inside `test/core-artifacts/`: a stray `.doc-detective/` breaks the fixture-bundle coverage test, and `.xml`/`.md` leftovers would be detected as documentation on later runs.

tests.description: Both reporters are selectable and write parseable output for a passing run.

runShell.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),{XMLParser}=require('fast-xml-parser');const b='.tmp/fixture-reporters/pass/out/';const d=new XMLParser({ignoreAttributes:false,attributeNamePrefix:'@_'}).parse(fs.readFileSync(b+'junit.xml','utf8'));const t=Number(d.testsuites['@_tests']);if(!(t>=1)){console.error('expected at least one testcase, got '+t);process.exit(1)}if(Number(d.testsuites['@_failures'])!==0){console.error('expected no failures');process.exit(1)}const m=fs.readFileSync(b+'doc-detective-summary.md','utf8');if(m.indexOf('# Doc Detective results')!==0){console.error('missing summary title');process.exit(1)}if(m.indexOf('| Steps |')<0){console.error('missing summary table');process.exit(1)}console.log('passing-run ok, testcases: '+t)"

tests.description: When `--output` names a file (the natural `--reporters json junit markdown` invocation), both reporters write their fixed filename beside it rather than treating the path as a directory.

runShell.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),{XMLParser}=require('fast-xml-parser');const b='.tmp/fixture-reporters/file-output/out/';if(!fs.statSync(b+'results.json').isFile()){console.error('results.json is not a file');process.exit(1)}new XMLParser().parse(fs.readFileSync(b+'junit.xml','utf8'));const m=fs.readFileSync(b+'doc-detective-summary.md','utf8');if(m.indexOf('# Doc Detective results')!==0){console.error('missing summary title');process.exit(1)}console.log('file-output ok')"

tests.description: A failing inner run produces a `<failure>` element and a markdown failures section. The inner run deliberately omits `--exit-on-fail`, so a FAILed inner test still exits 0 and this outer step passes.

runShell.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),{XMLParser}=require('fast-xml-parser');const b='.tmp/fixture-reporters/fail/out/';const x=fs.readFileSync(b+'junit.xml','utf8');const d=new XMLParser({ignoreAttributes:false,attributeNamePrefix:'@_'}).parse(x);if(Number(d.testsuites['@_failures'])<1){console.error('expected a failure count in junit.xml');process.exit(1)}if(x.indexOf('<failure')<0){console.error('expected a failure element');process.exit(1)}const m=fs.readFileSync(b+'doc-detective-summary.md','utf8');if(m.indexOf('## Failures')<0){console.error('expected a failures section');process.exit(1)}console.log('failing-run ok')"
